items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: We've been married about 15 years. We met in church.

ctx.x: Oh, oh, yeah. That's right. That's good. We've been married about 15 years. We met in church. Statenau's Baptist Church.
I just wanted people to know who you were, you know, when they hear this. That's his wife always picking on him. That's right.
